'''2026 Endor Regionals Ming Huo DS tdigwattv''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ming Huo]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Endor).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ming Huo]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Endor

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
